Scene:
所以，孟母和孟子搬到学校的旁边住。才五岁孟子开始学哲学。在学校，孟子不是看书，就是练习写字。将来，他成为中国的一个非常有名的哲学家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 才五岁孟子开始学哲学：就开始，才Num.就V.
- 将来，他成为中国的一个非常有名的哲学家：后来，“将来“ refers to the absolute future

Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 成为：成为了，Becoming a philosopher is presented as a completed change in the past, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: Coherence (Temporality): 成为中国的一个非常有名的哲学家：成为了中国的一个非常有名的哲学家，Becoming a philosopher is presented as a completed change of state, so 成为 takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 3: Coherence (Temporality): 成为：成为了，This is the completed later outcome of the story, so the verb needs `了`. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
